newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa gasoline prices rise by one cent/litre.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa gasoline prices rise by one cent/litre.

text.p: South Africa's Central Energy Fund said gasoline prices would rise by one cent per litre and diesel would rise by six cents with effect from October 2.
Illuminating paraffin would rise by 12 cents per litre.
The Central Energy Fund said the prices moves reflected relatively stable international gasoline prices but a sharp rise in the price of diesel andf paraffin.
From October 2 the price of 93 octane gasoline in the Gauteng area around Johannesburg will rise to 210 cents from 209 cents. At the coast the price goes to 200 from 199.

The price of diesel in Gauteng will be 204 cents, and 194 cents on the coast, while illuminating paraffin goes to 134.23 cents from 122.43 cents in Gauteng. At the coast, illuminating paraffin will be 123.43 cents from 111.43.
